summary: Payslip PDF Generation and HR Alerts System testing complete. All 11 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed. Payslip PDF endpoint generates valid PDF with employee data, earnings breakdown, deductions and net salary. HR Alerts panel displays on Dashboard with correct icons (Award for anniversary, Cake for birthday). PDF download button (FileDown icon) present in payroll table for each employee row.
critical_code_review_comments: Payslip PDF endpoint correctly uses reportlab to generate professional PDF with company header, employee info, earnings table, deductions table, and net salary
HR Alerts system correctly calculates alerts for contracts expiring (30/60/90 days), probation ending (15 days), work anniversaries (30 days), and birthdays (7 days)
HR Alerts are properly sorted by priority (critical > high > medium > low) then by days_remaining
HrAlertsPanel component uses correct icons: FileText for contracts, Shield for probation, Award for anniversary, Cake for birthday
PDF download button (FileDown icon) is present in payroll table Actions column for all employee rows
seed_data_creation: None - used existing payroll entries and employee data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payslip PDF generation and HR Alerts system fully functional. PDF endpoint at /api/payroll/payslip/{entry_id}/pdf returns valid PDF. HR Alerts endpoint at /api/hr-alerts returns alerts sorted by priority. Dashboard shows HrAlertsPanel with 2 current alerts (Ana Martinez Lopez: work anniversary in 16 days, birthday in 3 days).

backend.test: HR alerts have required fields (type, priority, employee_id, etc)
HR alerts sorted by priority then days_remaining
HR alerts summary counts match actual alerts
Payroll entry has all required fields for PDF

frontend.test: HR Alerts Panel visible on Dashboard
Award icon for work anniversary alert
PDF download buttons (FileDown) in payroll table

pdf_sections: Earnings table (base salary, overtime, bonuses, commissions)

payroll_pdf_button.available_for: All employee rows in both draft and paid periods
